name: Finance Agent Benchmark
intro: Finance Agent Benchmark评估智能体完成真实金融研究任务的能力。7位业界专家共同定义9类任务并编写537道需要多份公开文档或SEC申报文件的问题，每题含标准答案、来源和分步解法；问题经异人复核、作者终审和细粒度评分准则复核后，由具备四类检索工具的智能体作答。
build_method: 7位金融专家构建9类任务, 537题多文档标注, 异人交叉复核, GPT-4o生成并人工复核评分准则
metric: Class-balanced Accuracy, Naive Accuracy, Time and Cost per Query
modality: 文本, 网页, SEC申报文件, 工具轨迹
task_type: 金融信息检索, 数值推理, 趋势与市场分析, 金融建模
eval_feature: Google/EDGAR检索, HTML解析与键值存储检索, 细粒度合取评分准则, 矛盾检测
scale: 537题/9类；公开验证50、私有验证150、私有测试337
modality_en: Text, Web Pages, SEC Filings, Tool Trajectories
task_type_en: Financial Retrieval, Numerical Reasoning, Trend and Market Analysis, Financial Modeling
build_method_en: Nine-category Taxonomy by Seven Finance Experts, 537 Multi-document Items, Independent Peer Review, GPT-4o Rubric Generation plus Manual Review
eval_feature_en: Google/EDGAR Search, HTML Parsing and Key-value Retrieval, Fine-grained Conjunctive Rubrics, Contradiction Detection
intro_en: Finance Agent Benchmark evaluates agents on realistic financial research. Seven industry experts define nine task categories and author 537 questions requiring multiple public documents or SEC filings, each with a reference answer, sources, and step-by-step solution. Items undergo independent peer review, author final review, and manual verification of fine-grained rubrics before tool-equipped agents answer them.
scale_en: 537 questions / 9 categories; public validation 50, private validation 150, private test 337
metric_en: Class-balanced Accuracy, Naive Accuracy, Time and Cost per Query

drawio_review_note: Paper-aligned against arXiv:2508.00828v1 Sections 2.1-4.1, Tables 1-3, and Appendices A-C. Seven finance practitioners define nine categories containing 102 quantitative-retrieval, 97 qualitative-retrieval, 83 numerical-reasoning, 29 complex-retrieval, 43 adjustments, 69 beat-or-miss, 33 trends, 47 financial-modeling, and 34 market-analysis questions. Experts author 537 multi-document items from public sources, focusing on documents from 2024 onward; every item includes an answer, required sources, and a step-by-step solution, then receives different-expert review and author standardization. GPT-4o is prompted to return a JSON array of atomic operator/criteria checks from the expert answer; authors manually verify them and add a whole-answer contradiction check. Splits are public validation 50, private validation 150, and fully private test 337. The paper run uses the same user instruction without a system prompt, asks for FINAL ANSWER plus sources, sets temperature 0 where supported, and uses a 16,384-token maximum; the four tools are GoogleSearch, EdgarSearch, ParseHTML, and RetrieveInformation. Correctness is the conjunction of all correctness checks with no contradiction; the primary metric is the equal-weight mean of nine category accuracies, with naive accuracy, time, tool use, and cost also reported. Release audit pins vals-ai/finance-agent commit 82337852884d19017154f21bf8d7a4ae09e9896b (2026-04-13, post-paper) and public.csv SHA-256 901e8cff562819007d43ff0c10b43b2e386481eb40f2157ba18da8fbbe05bff5. The public repository exposes 50 rows only, containing 200 correctness rubrics and 50 contradiction rubrics; private items and Vals platform evaluation remain gated. Its current prompt fixes the date to April 07, 2025 and requires submit_final_result, while current CLI defaults are 32,000 tokens and 50 turns. The judge implementation and answer parser are not public in this pinned repository, so the diagram labels paper-defined scoring separately from reproducible public code.
